page: Amazon Web Services hpc7a.24xlarge is a high-performance computing instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores and 48 vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9R14 processor operating at a base frequency of 3.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory running at 5 GHz, providing 16.0 GB of RAM per core. There is no local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration bundled with this instance type. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 150 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the hpc7a.24xlarge demonstrates exceptional multi-core capabilities, placing in the top 10% for stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression. Memory performance is equally robust, with large-block read and write bandwidth tests scoring in the top 10%. Single-core performance, measured via Geekbench and stress-ng, ranks in the top 25%. The processor's support for advanced instruction sets, including AVX-512 and AVX512_BF16, contributes to top-tier results in Passmark extended instructions and physics tests.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated compute resources and DDR5 memory bandwidth without the added cost of local storage or GPU hardware. This makes it highly suitable for memory-bound and compute-intensive workloads. The instance is optimized for high-performance computing (HPC) applications, large-scale scientific simulations, software compilation, database operations, and multi-threaded data processing tasks.
